name: officepm
description: Self-hosted project management for a small office.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:conformance && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:data-compat
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tests/data-compat
scripts.dev: node -e "console.log('dev arrives in P1 (server) and P3 (web). Until then run the frozen v1 server with: node legacy/server.js'); process.exit(0)"
